findings.correction: “Go now.” / Shunk. / With a death rattle, the hulking green body slid down the wall.
findings.current: “Go on. It’s over.” / Thud. / With a final gurgle, the hulking green body slid down the wall.
findings.defect: 푹 is a piercing/plunge SFX for the finishing stab, not a dull impact. Thud makes the kill sound like a body blow or fall and drops the spear thrust.
findings.rationale: The kill beat is spear-in, death cry, slide. Rendering 푹 as Thud changes the mechanical action of the finishing blow.
findings.source: “가라, 이제.” / 푹. / 끄륵. 단말마와 함께 녹색 거체가 벽면을 타고 미끄러진다.

findings.correction: At that moment, I pressed down gently on the middle of the spear with one foot.
findings.current: At that moment, I pressed down firmly on the middle of my spear with one foot.
findings.defect: 지그시 is a gentle, steady press. Firmly adds effort and kills the gag that light pressure plus a three-digit Strength stat bends the spear.
findings.rationale: The comedy is effortless strength. Changing the pressure quality alters the action and the joke.
findings.source: 그 순간, 나는 한쪽 발로 창의 중앙을 지그시 눌렀다.

findings.correction: That was when I felt a stinging gaze from beside me.
findings.current: That was when I felt an icy gaze from beside me.
findings.defect: 따가운 is a hot, stinging glare, not a cold one.
findings.rationale: The source cue is burning/prickling scrutiny from Choi, the opposite temperature metaphor.

findings.correction: Hey, save the swearing. There’s one more.
findings.defect: Unquoted first-person aside, matching narration such as 그쪽이었냐, is turned into spoken dialogue the official would hear.
findings.rationale: This chapter quotes Taekyung’s speech. This line has no quotes and functions as narrator commentary, not a spoken line.
findings.source: 어, 욕 아껴 둬. 하나 더 있으니까.

findings.correction: So I asked him. / “Could you keep what concerns me a secret?”
findings.defect: The narration that he asked Choi is omitted, and the request is italicized as thought. The Korean is a spoken request about keeping matters concerning him secret.
findings.rationale: 부탁했다 frames a request to Choi, which the next paragraph treats as asking him for false testimony. Thought italics drop that speech act.
findings.source: 그래서 그에게 부탁했다. / ‘저에 관해서는 비밀로 해 주실 수 있을까요?’

findings.correction: I let out a sigh as if it could cave the ground in.
findings.current: I let out a deep sigh.
findings.defect: 땅이 꺼져라 is a hyperbolic sigh that could cave the earth in, echoing the fight where the ground was actually sinking. A plain deep sigh loses that comic beat.
findings.rationale: The exaggeration is the characterization and the callback, not optional intensity.

findings.correction: And he was rich, too. / “I never get to eat it.”
findings.current: And he was rich, too. / “Can’t get enough of it.”
findings.defect: After noting Choi is rich, 없어서 못 먹습니다 is ‘I never get to eat it / I can’t eat it because I don’t have it,’ not gluttonous ‘can’t get enough.’
findings.rationale: The line answers 한우 좋아해요 against the rich-man, top-grade-Hanwoo setup. Scarcity/poverty is the point; the current English reverses it into hearty appetite.
findings.source: 그리고 돈도 많은 인간이다. / “없어서 못 먹습니다.”

findings.correction: the Great Warrior involuntarily faltered backward.
findings.current: the Great Warrior involuntarily began taking small steps backward.
findings.defect: 주춤주춤 is faltering, hesitant retreat, not merely small steps.
findings.rationale: The source marks shock and unsteadiness after seeing the severed arm, not just reduced stride length.
findings.source: 대전사가 저도 모르게 주춤주춤 뒷걸음질 친다.

findings.defect: 시발 is the same hard swear rendered as fuck elsewhere in the chapter; Holy shit softens it.
findings.rationale: Rules require matching profanity strength. The hunters’ 시발 is already For fuck’s sake; this should not be milder.

summary: Actionable fidelity issues: the killing thrust SFX is rendered as a blunt thud; a gentle foot-press becomes firm; a stinging glare becomes icy; an unquoted aside is spoken; the secret request is demoted to thought and the asking verb is dropped; the earth-caving sigh gag is flattened; and 없어서 못 먹습니다 is read as appetite rather than scarcity.
